notes: Rafe, "decision gates": one harness sends eight decision-model checkpoints, trained classifiers and Qwen comparators the same typed requests; includes yes/no swap flips, out-of-scope acceptance at a held-out threshold and option-key-likelihood baselines. Jev numbers stored; open-checkpoint tables not stored. Qwen3.6-27B option-key likelihood scores 0.733 (typed-decisions) and 0.912 (CLINC-150), matching Jev (0.732 / 0.913): no qwen3.6-27b id exists in model-catalog, so that baseline is recorded in missing[]. Clef is not included. Colab L4 latencies for open models are not comparable with the hosted client latency.

claims.statement: Rafe: "Swapping yes and no flips 50.5 answers per hundred for Jev"; Qwen3.6-27B read via option-key likelihood "matches" Jev on typed-decisions (0.733 vs 0.732) and CLINC-150 (0.912 vs 0.913); at 5 percent risk Jev accepts 0.93 of CLINC-150 decisions and 0.13 of typed-decisions (likelihood readout 0.42), and "a held-out threshold for five percent in-scope risk still lets Jev accept 0.310 of out-of-scope requests". An intent-trained first stage escalating to Jev matches its accuracy at 0.43 of its cost.
claims.implication: Jev yes/no answers depend on label wording; abstention needs an explicit out-of-scope option AND a calibrated threshold.

scores.harness: One harness, eight decision-model checkpoints from six families incl. hosted Jev, trained classifiers, and Qwen likelihood baselines; typed-decisions, CLINC-150 (in-scope and out-of-scope), yes/no swap flip tests; latency/cost per platform

scores.caveat: Printed 0.913; decider-2b, this-that-model-1.0, Nimble-9B and Kev-9B cluster 0.850-0.863 (decider-2b trained on the CLINC-150 train split); a trained classifier reaches 0.940 and an embedding logistic regression 0.948.
